content:
Let Karlsson’s time per jam jar be \(x\) minutes, and per honey jar be \(y\) minutes.

\[
3x+y=25,\quad x+3y=35
\]

Solving:

\[
9x+3y=75,\quad x+3y=35 \implies 8x=40 \implies x=5
\]

So Karlsson eats jam at \(\frac15\) jar/min.

For Little Brother, let his time per jam jar be \(p\) minutes:

\[
3p+q=55,\quad p+3q=85
\]

\[
9p+3q=165,\quad p+3q=85 \implies 8p=80 \implies p=10
\]

So Little Brother eats jam at \(\frac1{10}\) jar/min.

Together their jam rate is:

\[
\frac15+\frac1{10}=\frac{3}{10}\text{ jars/min}
\]

Time for six jars:

\[
\frac{6}{3/10}=20
\]

\[
\boxed{20\text{ minutes}}
\]
